title: Incident priority — P0 critical
content: Active security breach, widespread data exposure, unauthorised money movement, complete production outage or irreversible corruption.

structured_data.definition: Active security breach, widespread data exposure, unauthorised money movement, complete production outage or irreversible corruption.
structured_data.response: Immediate containment; security/executive/legal involvement; continuous command until stable.

title: Incident priority — P1 high
content: Major customer/supplier workflow unavailable, payment or identity service materially impaired, high-risk privacy issue or repeated harmful automation.

structured_data.definition: Major customer/supplier workflow unavailable, payment or identity service materially impaired, high-risk privacy issue or repeated harmful automation.
structured_data.response: Owner within minutes; containment and stakeholder update; executive visibility.

title: Incident priority — P2 medium
content: Degraded non-critical function, limited user impact, repeated SLA breach or important integration issue with workaround.

structured_data.definition: Degraded non-critical function, limited user impact, repeated SLA breach or important integration issue with workaround.
structured_data.response: Department owner, timed recovery and root-cause review.

title: Incident priority — P3 low
content: Minor defect, isolated content issue or enhancement with no material risk.

structured_data.definition: Minor defect, isolated content issue or enhancement with no material risk.
structured_data.response: Backlog with owner and target release.
